pooled_caveat: This attribution-centered cluster is not a single issue area: it mixes praise, criticism, campaign commitments, and retrospective claims whose accuracy is asserted by the sampled documents.
pooled_summary: The central claims attribute achievements, failures, promises, and prospective actions to presidents or administrations across domestic and foreign policy. They compare leadership records from Clinton and Bush through Obama, Trump, and Biden, including infrastructure, health, security, rights, economic policy, alliances, and executive authority.
qualification: Source-bound assistant synthesis of period- and document-diverse central examples, not independent human certification or an exhaustive stance classification. Statements describe the observed documents across years, not every member's beliefs or a current consensus.
title: Presidential Leadership, Records, and Policy Commitments
